intro: One-stop OEM peptide solutions for brands, distributors, and research institutions — from formulation to delivery, fully managed by a dedicated project team.

services.title: Custom Formulation
services.description: Sequence design, modification optimization, and formulation development tailored to your target product profile, with sample confirmation before production.

services.title: Private Label Packaging
services.description: Your brand on the label, our quality inside the vial. Multi-spec filling (1mg to 100mg+ per vial), custom label and box design, and tamper-evident finishing.

services.title: Full Registration Dossier
services.description: Complete regulatory support documentation — quality standards, testing protocols, and stability data — prepared to accelerate your market entry.

services.title: Global Logistics
services.description: Lyophilized products packed with cold-chain protection and shipped through international express networks with tracking from our dock to yours.

services.title: Rigorous Quality Control
services.description: Every OEM batch runs the full analytical panel — HPLC purity, MS identity, peptide content, water content, and endotoxin — before release.

services.title: Dedicated Account Service
services.description: A single project manager tracks your OEM order from start to finish, providing technical consultation during development and after-sales support.

process.title: Requirement discussion
process.description: Share your target peptide, quantity, purity, and packaging needs. Our specialists review sequence feasibility and respond with a technical proposal.

process.title: Sample confirmation
process.description: We produce a pilot batch with your chosen formulation and packaging plan; you approve the sample before commercial production begins.

process.title: Terms and kick-off
process.description: Confirm technical and commercial terms, sign the supply agreement, and officially start the project with a dedicated project manager.

process.title: Production and QC
process.description: Synthesis, purification, lyophilization, filling, and full analytical QC run under batch-record control with QA-reviewed release.

process.title: Delivery and support
process.description: Cold-chain international shipping with tracking, complete COA documentation, and after-sales technical support for your customers.

cta: Chat with our OEM specialists — get a custom proposal within 24 hours.
